currentInterests.description: A lot of my current curiosity goes into discussing deep theories with a friend — proposing ideas, trying to break them, rebuilding them, and seeing where the reasoning leads. The discussions range across physics, space, consciousness, and other fundamental questions.
I've been learning the fundamentals of AI and machine learning through MIT coursework, including basic concepts such as linear regression and working with data.
Currently studying physics at the JEE level, building a stronger foundation in mechanics, electromagnetism, modern physics, and the mathematical tools used to describe physical systems.
I regularly read about psychology, cognition, behavior, decision-making, and the ways people perceive and respond to the world around them.

A recurring rabbit hole, especially when discussing fundamental questions about the universe. I read about astronomy and space and often connect those ideas back to the deeper theories I discuss with my friend.
I occasionally read about the deep ocean, its extreme environments, unusual organisms, and the parts of our planet that remain poorly understood.
